title: Boot configuration
statement: Let $S$ be a finite deterministic Boolean machine, $A$ a finite nondeterministic Boolean machine, and let the loop flag be Boolean. Given a configuration of $S$ on input $x$, define the host configuration with the same input-head position, $S$'s work-tape contents and head positions, and output; its state is the boot phase with $S$'s current state when present, or the rewind phase when $S$ has halted. The additional work tapes are blank, with their heads at the origin.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of the host-configuration constructor, so the exact placement of the output and auxiliary tapes cannot be confirmed.
